stories.name_fr: Volume moyen par restaurant Taco Bell US visé à 2030
stories.name_en: Taco Bell US average unit volume target by 2030
stories.explanation: Objectif de croissance aux États-Unis, contre 2,2 M $ aujourd’hui.
stories.story_fr: Taco Bell vise un volume annuel moyen par restaurant de 3 millions de dollars aux États-Unis d’ici 2030, contre 2,2 millions actuellement.
stories.story_en: Taco Bell aims to raise U.S. annual average unit volumes from $2.2 million to $3 million by 2030.
stories.citation: increasing annual average unit volumes from $2.2 million to $3 million

stories.name_fr: Restaurants Taco Bell hors États-Unis visés à 2030
stories.name_en: Taco Bell restaurants outside the U.S. by 2030
stories.explanation: Plus de 3 000 restaurants hors États-Unis, contre 1 150 en 2024.
stories.story_fr: Taco Bell vise plus de 3 000 restaurants hors des États-Unis d’ici 2030, contre 1 150 en 2024.
stories.story_en: Taco Bell targets over 3,000 restaurants outside the U.S. by 2030, from 1,150 locations as of 2024.
stories.citation: global footprint to expand from 1,150 locations as of 2024 to over 3,000 restaurants outside the U.S.

stories.name_fr: Ventes système Cantina Chicken visées à 2030
stories.name_en: Cantina Chicken system sales target by 2030
stories.explanation: Ventes système de la gamme Cantina Chicken.
stories.story_fr: Taco Bell vise 5 milliards de dollars de ventes système pour les produits Cantina Chicken d’ici 2030.
stories.story_en: Taco Bell aims for Cantina Chicken items to reach $5 billion in system sales by 2030.
stories.citation: Aiming for Cantina Chicken Menu items to reach $5 billion in system sales and beverages to reach $5 billion in system sales by 2030

stories.name_fr: Ventes système de boissons visées à 2030
stories.explanation: Ventes système des boissons, portées notamment par Live Más Café.
stories.story_fr: Taco Bell vise 5 milliards de dollars de ventes système de boissons d’ici 2030.
stories.story_en: Taco Bell aims for beverages to reach $5 billion in system sales by 2030.
stories.citation: Aiming for Cantina Chicken Menu items to reach $5 billion in system sales and beverages to reach $5 billion in system sales by 2030

stories.explanation: Hausse de 32 % des ventes digitales en 2024.
stories.story_fr: Les ventes digitales de Taco Bell atteignent 6 milliards de dollars en 2024, en hausse de 32 %.
stories.story_en: Taco Bell digital sales reached $6 billion in 2024, up 32%.
stories.citation: Technological and operational investments unlocked 32% growth in digital sales, totaling $6 billion.

stories.explanation: Premier milliard de profit pour la marque.
stories.story_fr: Taco Bell atteint pour la première fois 1 milliard de dollars de profit en 2024.
stories.story_en: Taco Bell reached $1 billion in profit for the first time in 2024.
stories.citation: The company reached a milestone of $1 billion in profit for the first time ever in 2024

stories.name_fr: Restaurants Taco Bell dans le monde fin 2024
stories.name_en: Taco Bell restaurants worldwide at end of 2024
stories.story_fr: Taco Bell compte 8 757 restaurants dans le monde, après 347 ouvertures brutes en 2024.
stories.story_en: Taco Bell has 8,757 restaurants worldwide after 347 gross new openings in 2024.
